title: System Synchronization
hook: My content was great and my sales process was great. They just never talked to each other.
statement: Your systems have to work together. Good systems that clash still waste each other's output.
explainer: Content brings in leads at the wrong time, sales can't follow up, delivery gets slammed. Each piece looks fine alone, but the handoffs are where the money leaks.
sop: Map your main systems: content, sales, delivery, admin.
Mark where one system's timing or output jams up another.
Count your Aligned Systems against your Total Systems.
Fix the timing, order, or owner so handoffs run clean.
Re-map monthly. Every new system needs syncing in.
equation_example: 3 Aligned Systems out of 5 Total Systems. 3 ÷ 5 = 60%. Higher means your systems push in the same direction. Lower means they're quietly cancelling out each other's work.
question: Name the two systems in your business that are fighting each other right now.
closing_statement: Out-of-sync systems undo each other's progress.
caption:
